analogy.rationale: Carboxylesterase inhibitors target CES1 and BCHE, enzymes with limited expression in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other serine hydrolase/esterase inhibitors such as cholinesterase and FAAH inhibitors, which share substrate/enzyme-family overlap but little downstream program in these cells.
